findings.message: D-STORY:AC-002 requires a Playwright test for the origin-centered radius-six circle, but the evidence records run `TA-cba6bdac8c1636628205` under command `.-node-tests`; the implementation summary identifies `tests/graph-plotter.spec.js` as Vitest coverage and says a real Playwright geometry run remains separate.

D-STORY:AC-004 is marked verified and D-STORY:REQ-004 is marked verified, but the evidence table says `no tagged test` and provides no desktop/tablet visual witness. The only inspected screenshot is a single initial graph; it cannot establish representative desktop and tablet usability.

The agent brief recommends release because every requirement is verified, yet the same document leaves the Playwright circle run and responsive visual inspection unrecorded. This overstates the acceptance and visual assurance for a repeatable verification result.
